segments.source: Overview

segments.contextBefore: Use anchor devices to improve the accuracy of indoor positioning.
segments.contextAfter: Downlink Time-Difference-of-Arrival (DL-DTOA) is a system that allows the Nearby Interaction framework to interact with fixed Ultra-wide band (UWB) devices — known as *anchors* — in an indoor space to increase the accuracy of positioning by measuring the time difference of arrival of signals from multiple anchors to an iOS device.
